msg: The colours of the gnomes are (pink/purple) and (green/brown). On the screen it will always be one gnome from each of these colour groups. Pick any colour to tsart with ie. pink the only choose pink or purple untill the no. of mushrooms you get goes 2 or below then start choosing the green and brown gnomes on the screen until the numbe of mushrooms you get goes low again. Click as fast as you can and stay focused as you dont get a break. Good luck
